name: Rough Fist
description: Swing a rough hard fist with earth qi bunched in the knuckles to break guards and ribs.

name: Boulder Tread
description: Stride forward with a weighted step that drives the foot down and sets up the next blow.

name: Rubble Elbow
description: Drive a hardened elbow into the target at close range with the full turn of the hips.

name: Crack Guard
description: Split an incoming strike off to the side with a forearm hardened to the grain of stone.

name: Stonebreak Palm
description: Slam a palm loaded with earth qi onto a raised guard so the shock runs through the arm and breaks the stance.

name: Splitting Fist
description: Drive a narrow fist into one point so qi rams through plate or bone like a wedge through rock.

name: Scree Slide
description: Loosen a patch of gravel under the target so the footing slides downhill from beneath the heel.

name: Footing Heave
description: Heave the ground under the opponent's lead foot up and over to spoil the step.

name: Earth Prop
description: Raise a short post of earth beside the body to take a shove or hold the user upright.

name: Back Settle
description: Slide the rear foot back and let the ground firm behind it so the retreat ends balanced.

name: Sinkpatch
description: Soften a small circle of ground so the opponent's foot drops through the crust to the ankle.

name: Stone Knock
description: Rap a rising knob of stone against an incoming blade and knock it off its line.

name: Rolling Heave
description: Send a rolling swell through packed earth that lifts and drops everyone standing in its path.

name: Fault Slip
description: Shear the ground along a line between user and foe so the foe's charge ends on the wrong side of a step.

name: Earth Board
description: Pull a flat board of packed earth up from the ground and hold it against a blow.

name: Packed Plank
description: Press qi into the ground in front of the knees and stand a narrow plank of dense soil upright.

name: Brace Wedge
description: Kick a wedge of hardened earth behind the rear foot so a shove cannot drive the user back.

name: Dirt Veil
description: Throw up a curtain of loose dirt that blinds a charging foe for a heartbeat.

name: Load Shed
description: Let a raised earth shield crumble just as the blow lands so the force dies in falling soil.

name: Layered Shield
description: Stack three plates of packed earth in front of the body and renew each as the blows break it.

name: Slab Rebound
description: Angle a raised slab so a thrown stone or arrow strikes it and flies back toward the one who sent it.

name: Clay Wrap
description: Draw wet clay up the target's shin in a band that tightens as the foe steps.

name: Sticky Cling
description: Turn the ground under the target to sticky bog that drags at both boots.

name: Muck Step
description: Cross soft wet ground by firming it a half-breath before each footfall.

name: Mud Tug
description: Pull on the wet clay holding the foe's foot to drag them off balance toward the user.

name: Mud Smear
description: Fling a clot of mud at the eyes so the target must wipe their vision clear.

name: Mud Fist
description: Coat the fist in dense wet clay that adds weight and clings to what it hits.

name: Hardening Clay
description: Let the clay round a foe's legs bake stiff under earth qi until the legs cannot be lifted.

name: Quag Hold
description: Hold a wide patch of quagmire round several foes so every attempt to move sinks them deeper.

name: Silt Collar
description: Wind silt about a foe's arms and chest in a thick loose collar that pins both elbows to the ribs.

name: Rock Tear
description: Tear a heavy stone free of the ground with qi so it sits ready at the user's feet.

name: Boulder Toss
description: Heave a loose boulder from the hip in a flat line at the nearest target.

name: Stone Hurl
description: Whip a fist-sized stone forward off the shoulder so it arrives hard and fast.

name: Skip Stone
description: Throw a flat stone low so it skips off the ground and rises into the legs of the foe.

name: Rock Sling
description: Whirl a stone on a loop of qi and release it at the target from the side.

name: Putting Stone
description: Push a rounded stone out from the neck with a straight arm and a step to carry it far.

name: Rock Raise
description: Lift a heavy rock in front of the body to catch a thrown spear or stone.

name: Boulder Hurl
description: Wind up with the whole body and fling a man-sized boulder in a long straight line.

name: Rolling Boulder
description: Send a boulder rolling along the ground with a steady push of qi so it crushes whatever stands in its line.

name: Rock Barrage
description: Lift a ring of stones and fling them one after another at a single clump of targets.

name: Deep Listen
description: Send a thin thread of qi into the ground and read the answering shiver from far away.

name: Echo Find
description: Strike the ground and hear which places beneath answer hollow and which answer solid.

name: Vein Trace
description: Follow a seam of ore or a buried line of rock with qi to learn where it runs.

name: Muffled Tread
description: Place each foot so its weight passes into the earth without sound and the tremor stays small.

name: Strata Feel
description: Press a palm to rock and learn the layers below by how the qi sinks through them.

name: Pulse Mark
description: Tap a pulse into the ground and mark each living body whose steps break the return.

name: Stone Ear
description: Keep a sleeping net of qi in the ground around the user that wakes at any heavy step.

name: Far Footfall
description: Read the weight and gait of marchers far off through the earth and tell allies what comes.

name: Plate Forearm
description: Cover the forearm in a hard plate of stone and block with its flat face.

name: Brow Plate
description: Form a small plate of rock over the brow and temple against a glancing blow to the head.

name: Shin Plate
description: Harden the front of the shin into a plate that takes a low kick without cracking bone.

name: Plate Fist
description: Close a stone-plated fist and strike so the plating adds an edge to the blow.

name: Plate Breath
description: Hold one steady breath while earth qi spreads under the skin and stiffens the whole frame.

name: Layered Plating
description: Build overlapping plates of earth across chest and back and mend each as it chips.

name: Plated Rush
description: Charge shoulder-first with the plating set so the rush hits like a falling slab and takes return blows.

name: Needle Rock
description: Draw a thin needle of rock out of the ground and prick the target's foot.

name: Thorn Stone
description: Raise a hooked thorn of stone from beside the user's hand and jab it at an exposed wrist.

name: Pin Stone
description: Drive a short stone peg through the hem or sleeve of a foe and fix it to the ground.

name: Point Brace
description: Raise a stone point to meet a thrust and push the foe's weapon off its line.

name: Flint Needle
description: Flick a flint needle charged with qi so it lands in the face or hand.

name: Spike Step
description: Raise a spike from the ground and use it as a foothold to vault a low obstacle.

name: Stone Spike
description: Thrust a sharp spear of rock up beneath the target's feet in one hard push of qi.

name: Rising Lance
description: Raise a long lance of stone at an angle so it lifts the target off the ground as it pierces.

name: Thorn Row
description: Raise a row of low spikes across the ground that pins cloaks and ankles and pricks every foot that crosses.
